wizard.title: Set up your school website

address.label: Your web address
address.taken: This address is already used. Try another one.
address.invalid: Use 3 to 30 letters, numbers or hyphens. Do not start or end with a hyphen.

done.title: Your website is ready
done.body: Look at it first, then publish when you are happy.

wizard.error: We could not finish setting up. Please try again.

logo.title: School logo (optional)
logo.svgRefused: Please use a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
logo.tooLarge: This photo is too big. Use one under 20 MB.
logo.unreadable: We could not read this photo.
logo.pan: Use the arrow keys to move the photo and plus or minus to zoom.

overview.title: Website

off.title: Your school has no website yet
off.body: Set one up in a few steps. You can look at it before anyone else sees it.

turnOff.title: Turn the website off?
turnOff.body: People will no longer see your website. You can turn it on again any time.

turnOn.title: Turn the website on?
turnOn.body: Your published website will be visible to everyone.

overview.saveError: We could not save that. Please try again.
overview.stale: Someone else changed the website. Reload and try again.
overview.copyFailed: We could not copy the link.
overview.previewError: The preview is not ready. Please try again.

publishConfirm.title: Publish the website?
publishConfirm.body: Everyone will see the changes you made.

address.title: Web address
address.changeNote: The old address keeps working for 30 days and sends people to the new one.

own.title: Your own address
own.body: Use an address you already own, like www.myschool.edu.bd.
own.notMatched: The address has not matched yet. Add the line below in your address settings, then check again.

address.saveError: We could not save that. Please try again.

help.address: This is the address people type to find your school website, like yourschool.example.com.
help.ownAddress: If your school already has an address, like www.myschool.edu.bd, you can use it instead.
help.colours: Colours are used for buttons, headings and the top bar of your website.
help.textStyle: The text style sets how the headings and the writing on your website look.
